summary: Accepted as a stylized form pass, not an exact replica. Geometric hip courses, dormers, pediment, window grids, three open entrance bays, two balcony arches, street furniture, people, plaque and cloud lobes are built. Geometry IoU 0.8675. Canopy density, low-contrast materials and simplified base still limit reference similarity; material and lighting work remains. Rear is unobserved and simplified.

features.notes: Clock, pediment, slender shaft and long arched blue window present.
Stepped red hip roofs with dormers, parapets and actual geometric courses.
Open three-bay arcade and aligned stair, road, crosswalks, people and plaque. Base notches remain simplified.
Repeated window bays and paired upper arches hold across side views; frames are stylized.
Plate-like tiers replaced by smaller connected cloud lobes; broad placement matches, exact branch/leaf topology is approximate.
